continuityRules: Conversation history is never an execution authority.
The structural A-B-C-D microplan may not be replaced by a new plan because of an integration defect, visualization defect, new source re-upload, or intermediate finding.
New findings are nested inside their existing block and must update CONTROL_PLANE cursor/evidence, not create a parallel block, workflow, importer, repo, Firebase project, or methodology.
Completed modules I6.0-I6.4 are not reopened without a concrete reproducible causal regression.
I6.5 remains fail-closed for data writes until Block B read-path hydration is LIVE PASS and deterministic diff is physically frozen.
A source re-upload with identical SHA-256 is provenance reinforcement only; it never resets the cursor or creates a new source version.
Every product-source correction must prove same-artifact Preview to LIVE, exact hosted readback, authenticated functional behavior, preserved I6.4 sentinels, and zero unrelated/data writes.
Every pure data step must bind pinned source SHA, current LIVE readback, deterministic diff, exact allowed collections, write counts, post-write readback, and rollback evidence.

Recibos Esperados, Cartera Primas and Cobros remain semantically separate. No payment/cobro may be inferred from schedule, balance disappearance, commission evidence, one-source evidence, proposal, HOLD, or frequency alone.

sourceComplementarity.precedence: No single file replaces another. Field-level evidence is combined only under the frozen policy/receipt identity and inference rules.

semanticInvariants.receiptExpected: contractual installment/receipt obligation; never payment proof by itself
semanticInvariants.portfolio: premium balance/obligation state; balance reconciliation is not payment
semanticInvariants.cobro: confirmed/evidenced payment under accepted reconciliation contract only
